text:
Afternoon ramp crew,
The cargo lead sent an update on handover calls

Team,

Quick heads-up from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways: keep the animal files moving cleanly and flag any mismatch before the crate gets near the aircraft. <<FACT F077>> Keep the checks calm and steady, and make sure every note is readable when it reaches the cabin team. Safety still beats speed every time, and the cabin team needs a clean handoff to monitor animals properly once they are onboard.

If Pepper, or any other pet on the list, shows a gap in paperwork, park the case and route it back to us instead of guessing. <<FACT F065>> I want a clear line between acceptance and boarding, with no loose ends, no rushed edits, and no last-minute surprises at the stand. If you are unsure about a detail, send it up right away and do not let it roll forward on hope alone.

Keep the handover calls tight, keep the notes simple, and keep the crew informed so we can move the next wave without drama. Thanks for staying sharp and protecting the animals first.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
